a1-unit-33.33.1 Robots:
Paulo: Hi everyone, and welcome back to my channel! Today I'm at my grandmother's house in Rio Claro, and my sister is here too. She's a doctor. So, what will robots do for us in the next ten years?
Ana: Robots will certainly be very important. For example, robots will clean our houses. A lot of people have robot vacuum cleaners now, and in the future most people will have one.
Paulo: Great! So I'll relax on the sofa, and the robot will clean my apartment. Will robots teach our children?
Ana: I don't think robots will teach children. Computers will be important at school, but robots won't be very good teachers. Children need people.
Paulo: And what about hospitals?
Ana: I believe robots will help doctors with operations. Some hospitals already use robots in operations. And I predict that one day we'll have very small robots inside our bodies. They'll probably be very expensive at first.
Paulo: Will robots be dangerous?
Ana: Robots in wars will possibly be dangerous. But people control robots. I think people will always be more dangerous than robots!
Paulo: Good point. And now, a surprise for Grandma! This is Buddy, a small robot for older people. Say hello, Buddy.
Buddy: Hello. Nice to meet you. I can play games and help you remember your medicine.
Lourdes: Oh, how lovely! Let's play cards!
Buddy: No. I don't want to.
Lourdes: What? I'm ninety-six, and I always win at cards!
Paulo: Sorry, Grandma! Buddy still has some technical problems. I'm turning him off. I hope he'll be ready next week.
Lourdes: Well, I won't wait for a robot. Get the cards, Paulo!
